headline: Americans Donated Record $617.2B to Charity in 2025
meta_description: American charitable giving reached $617.2 billion in 2025, the first time donations crossed $600 billion, driven by major gifts from donors like MacKenzie Scot…
summary_short: For the first time ever, Americans gave over $600 billion to charity in a single year, with megagifts helping push the total to $617.2 billion.
body:
American charitable giving reached a historic milestone in 2025: $617.2 billion in total donations, the first time the nation's generosity has crossed the $600 billion threshold.

The surge was driven partly by major gifts from philanthropists, with MacKenzie Scott among the largest donors contributing to this record year. The scale of megagifts played a significant role in pushing overall giving to unprecedented heights, reflecting both the wealth of top donors and their commitment to causes across the country.

This milestone signals growing momentum in American philanthropy, even as nonprofits continue facing urgent needs in education, health, poverty relief, and social services. The record demonstrates that when individuals of means step forward, they can help move the needle on giving nationwide.
